personality_one_liner: A friendly, energetic, and touchable sports tracking app that feels like a weekend game with friends, using warm creams, turf green, and playful yellow accents.

spacing.rule: Make the interface feel touchable: use chunky cards, rounded containers, oversized tap areas, and clear foreground/background layering.

do's: Sticky header over scrolling player list

screens.name: Home Dashboard (Lista Semanal)
screens.purpose: Provide an immediate overview of this week's football match, attendance, and financials, with quick-action toggles for presence and BBQ.

states.empty: Playful illustration of a lonely football with text 'Nenhum jogador confirmado ainda!' and 'Adicionar Jogador' primary CTA.
states.error: Message 'Não foi possível carregar a lista' com botão 'Tentar Novamente'.

screens.layout: 1. Glass sticky header over a subtle background photo of a football pitch. 2. A 'Resumo Financeiro' top card (Total R$, Mensalistas R$60, Convidados R$20, Churrasco R$20) as a horizontal scroll or 2x2 grid. 3. Section titled 'Jogadores'. 4. Chunky list cards for each member. Each card has an Avatar (Initials), Name, Type badge (Mensalista/Convidado), a primary toggle for 'Vai Jogar?', and a secondary toggle (pill with flame/meat icon) for '+ Churrasco R$20'. 5. Sticky FAB 'Share via WhatsApp' bottom right. Sticky primary button 'Adicionar Jogador' anchored at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView/Safe area.

screens.name: Adicionar Jogador (Modal/Sheet)
screens.purpose: A bottom sheet to quickly register a new player into the team database.

states.error: Error message se o nome estiver vazio.

screens.layout: BottomSheet with a drag handle. Title 'Novo Jogador'. A large text input for 'Nome do Jogador' (label above input). A Segmented Control or two large selectable chunky cards side-by-side for type: 'Mensalista (R$60)' vs 'Convidado (R$20)'. A prominent sticky 'Salvar' button at the bottom.

hero_pitch_background.alt: Close-up of a white line on green grass in a soccer field

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Personality 4 (Tactile / Playful) to create a friendly, sports-community feel. Fredoka + Nunito give it a casual, approachable touch.
Implement chunky interactive cards for the player list. The user should easily toggle 'Vai Jogar' and '+ Churrasco' on each card.
Place the hero_pitch_background image at the top of the Home Dashboard with a gradient-to-dark scrim fading down, overlaying the Financial Summary on top of it.

Ensure 'Mensalista' and 'Convidado' visual badges differentiate the player types. e.g., Mensalista gets a solid brandTertiary badge with onBrandTertiary text, and Convidado gets a subtle surfaceTertiary badge.
Financial Summary should break down the total into three small data points: 'Mensalidades', 'Convidados', and 'Churrasco', with a large 'Total Arrecadado' sum.
Include a Floating Action Button for 'Share via WhatsApp' (using Phosphor WhatsappLogo) and a sticky block at the bottom for 'Adicionar Jogador' inside a Safe Area.
Wire up haptics on player toggles (Vai jogar? / Churrasco) using expo-haptics to provide tactile confirmation.
Do NOT use pure white cards on pure white backgrounds; use the warm surface (#FDFBF7) background behind the surfaceSecondary (#FFFFFF) chunky cards for depth.
The Churrasco image can be used as a visual header in the 'Resumo Financeiro' or Churrasco info panel if needed.
